messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Using venlafaxine with other drugs that make you drowsy can worsen this effect.
Ask your doctor before using opioid medication, a sleeping pill, a muscle relaxer, or medicine for anxiety or seizures.
Tell your doctor about all your current medicines.
Many drugs can affect venlafaxine, especially:
any other antidepressant, or other medicines containing venlafaxine or desvenlafaxine;
amphetamines;
fentanyl;
cimetidine;
tramadol;
St. John's wort, tryptophan (sometimes called L-tryptophan);
diet pills, weight loss medicine (such as phentermine);
a blood thinner (warfarin, Coumadin, Jantoven);
medicine to treat mood disorders, thought disorders, or mental illness - buspirone, lithium, and many others; or
migraine headache medicine - sumatriptan, zolmitriptan, and others.
This list is not complete and many other drugs may interact with venlafaxine.
List includes prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products.
Not all possible drug interactions are listed here.
Triplet: ["venlafaxine", "should be used with caution with", "medicine for anxiety or seizures"]

The relation 'should be used with caution with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may require special caution or medical supervision when used in conjunction with the entity specified by the object.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:

B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
D. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
E. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
